description: Zone a traffico limitato is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Emilia Romagna. Le zone a traffico limitato (ZTL), in Italia, sono aree nelle quali viene limitato l accesso a particolari categorie di veicoli, permanentemente oppure in determinate fasce orarie La ZTL di Modena comprende l area del centro storico ed e controllata da telecamere di controllo, attive 24 ore su 24, poste in corrispondenza dei principali punti ... Coverage: Regione Emilia Romagna. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Emilia Romagna. Its tags are limitato, traffico, zone. It offers 3 resource(s) in MAP_SRVC, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
